PAIR_EXECUTION_VALID: Full and Reduced use the same timestamp and capture hash
each profile output is produced through an explicit deterministic lineage
only inputs allowed under the frozen profile are used
no future information or outcome is used
no substitution is introduced outside frozen semantics
IDENTIFYING_OPPORTUNITY: the lane has at least one dependency that can legally differ between Full and Reduced
the differentiating dependency is point-in-time available to Full or its exclusion is mechanically consequential
the frozen evaluator is proven to consume that dependency under pre-existing semantics

readiness_rule: Only IDENTIFYING_OPPORTUNITY rows/windows may advance B2 readiness.
fail_closed_rule: A deterministic profile-independent fallback may remain as technical provenance but is not identifying evidence.
pre_r1_rule: A pre-R1 v2 receipt is PRE_R1_B2_VALIDITY_UNPROVEN unless separately validated under this contract.
